silence.text: Installment 1 is overdue. The Warden is out; the interest is not. The PA is silent for six hours.

apology.text: Apology form 9-A: 'We regret nothing, in writing.' Guards left a supply cache unmanned. The office is out of the Warden.

raid.label: Raid the supply cache
raid.text: The cache is lighter. The audit will be heavier.
raid.hint: +30 refined, +10 parts. Audit parts +20% for 5 days.

respect.label: Respect the quiet
respect.text: Debt adjusted: clerical error. The Warden notes your restraint and, regrettably, your quota.

effects.title: Clerical Error
effects.text: Quota memo, misfiled: 'The sentence is the product.'

respect.hint: Debt -2% (clerical error). Unlocks a quota clue.

sabotage.label: Sabotage the terminal
sabotage.text: The terminal sparks. Nobody is auditing anything for three days.
sabotage.hint: PA, audits and reviews off 3 days. Petition fee -20%, waves +10%.
